dependencies:
  validasi: 1.0.0-dev.x

# For Dart projects
dart pub add validasi

# For Flutter projects
flutter pub add validasi

import 'package:validasi/validasi.dart';
import 'package:validasi/rules.dart';
dart pub global activate validasi_mcp

# Start the server (stdio mode)
dart run bin/validasi_mcp.dart

# Force re-fetch all docs
dart run bin/validasi_mcp.dart --refresh

# Clear the local cache
dart run bin/validasi_mcp.dart --clean-cache
codex mcp add validasi_docs -- validasi_mcp --force-roots-fallback
claude mcp add --transport stdio validasi_docs -- validasi_mcp

final ageSchema = Validasi.number<int>([
	Rules.number.between(0, 120),
]);

print(ageSchema.validate(25).isValid); // true
print(ageSchema.validate(0).isValid); // true
print(ageSchema.validate(120).isValid); // true
print(ageSchema.validate(-1).isValid); // false
print(ageSchema.validate(121).isValid); // false
